title: Magic Emperor
altTitles: The Servant Is the Demon King?!
How the Demon Emperor Became a Butler
description: Zhuo Yifan was once the powerful Magic Emperor, possessing the ancient Book of the Nine Secrets. After being betrayed and killed by those he trusted, his soul is reborn in the body of Zhuo Fan, a lowly servant of the declining Luo Family. Bound by a mysterious heart demon, he must serve the family while secretly rebuilding his cultivation and using his knowledge from his former life to lead the Luo Family back to the peak of the continent.
author: Nightingale / No Two Comics / Wuer Manhua / Ye Xiao
